labels.name_vi: Thiếu bằng chứng ngoài trong input
labels.definition: Input lacks necessary information; this does not assert missing parametric knowledge.
labels.support_requires: Contrast or reviewed deterministic evidence-sufficiency replay establishes input deficiency; input may be insufficient.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.name_vi: Giả thuyết thiếu tri thức tham số
labels.definition: The tested model fails a controlled parametric-knowledge probe.
labels.support_requires: Closed-book/evidence controls distinguish contextual deficiency and reading/reasoning alternatives; recovery alone is insufficient.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.name_vi: Giả thuyết tri thức tham số sai
labels.definition: A persistent factual conflict is hypothesized in parametric knowledge.
labels.support_requires: Verified dated source plus controlled probes; a wrong output alone establishes a factual error, not its internal origin.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: Necessary premises are present but combining/calculation fails.
labels.support_requires: Verified premises and a matched reasoning/tool contrast; calculator effects remain distinct from prompt effects.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: Interpretation of entity, relation, scope or negation is hypothesized to fail.
labels.support_requires: Matched representation/reading contrast with unchanged required facts.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.name_vi: Giả thuyết tuân thủ yêu cầu
labels.definition: An explicit output/task constraint is violated.
labels.support_requires: Matched instruction contrast; raw violation is descriptive evidence only.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: A versioned corpus contains relevant evidence but the retriever misses it.
labels.support_requires: Corpus evidence availability, retrieval trace and reviewed matched/oracle contrast.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: Relevant retrieved evidence is lost, truncated or misplaced during assembly.
labels.support_requires: Retrieval-to-input trace and controlled assembly contrast or deterministic replay.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: Supplied relevant evidence is not used correctly by the generator.
labels.support_requires: Matched context-use contrast; do not classify as a retriever failure.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: Scaffold, tool interface or cap changes the response.
labels.support_requires: Same-model/item matched harness contrast with explicit controls.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: Raw output and parsed prediction differ in a way that changes scoring.
labels.support_requires: Hash-linked deterministic parser replay or matched parser contrast; do not alter frozen source scores.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.definition: Gold or metric representation causes a misleading correctness measurement.
labels.support_requires: Reviewed references and hash-linked deterministic scoring/gold comparison; source scores remain intact.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

labels.name_vi: Giả thuyết bất ổn giữa lần chạy
labels.definition: Repeated same-condition outputs produce inconsistent outcomes.
labels.support_requires: Registered same-condition repetitions and declared stability criterion; one output is insufficient.
labels.caveat: Human signoff and confidence do not establish controlled attribution.

observed_issues.name_vi: Đáp án không phù hợp câu hỏi/nguồn
Input thiếu dữ kiện cần thiết
Trace retrieval không lấy được evidence
Evidence bị mất khi ghép context
Raw output khác prediction đã parse
Kết quả biến động giữa lần chạy
Vấn đề khác được mô tả

attribution_status_definitions.hypothesis: Artifact-based candidate explanation; no controlled attribution claim.
attribution_status_definitions.contrast_supported: A registered, hash-verified, reviewed controlled contrast or deterministic replay supports this specific hypothesis.

action_label_rule: Action labels require prospective intervention outcomes and budget policy. Unknown cause is an empty hypothesis set; mixed attribution is derived from multiple supported hypotheses.
